notes: IMPORTANT: this produces only ONE line of what should be a balanced two-line posting (debit depreciation expense, credit accumulated depreciation) -- the same double-entry requirement as journal_entries_header.json/general_ledger_lines.json, but this source has only one amount column per row, unlike General Ledger's paired Debit_Amount/Credit_Amount. The engine has no 'expand one row into a balanced multi-line document' capability yet. Treat this output as a per-asset depreciation record for reference, NOT as a loadable balanced ACDOCA document -- see depreciation_field_mapping.csv and assets_worked_example.md.
